events.event: Coordinating Minister Yusril Ihza Mahendra is scheduled to attend a National Economic Council (DEN) invitation to hear DEN's fuller explanation of Luhut Pandjaitan's proposal to change the legal definition of corruption.
events.key_numbers: Meeting Mon 26 Oct 2026 (time not given) · proposal concerns the state-loss (kerugian negara) element · Yusril 24 Oct: 'baru wacana' (only a discourse)
events.why_it_matters: Whether the state-loss rule behind most corruption convictions changes affects how every pejabat can be prosecuted; the first official reading of the idea comes this week.
events.spreading_evidence: Kompas, Suara, Okezone, Media Indonesia analyses 22-24 Oct

events.event: Yusril Ihza Mahendra says the DEN proposal to change the definition of corruption is only a preliminary idea (wacana) that needs careful study, especially on how it fits the UN Convention against Corruption (UNCAC) in substantive and procedural law.
events.key_numbers: Statement Sat 24 Oct 2026 · amendment history cited: UU 31/1999 amended by UU 20/2001
events.why_it_matters: The minister overseeing law policy calls it an early idea, not a draft bill, which cools the debate over scrapping 'kerugian negara'.

events.event: KPK re-summons suspect DE, work-unit head (Kasatker) of PJN 1 North Sumatra, who skipped the 22 Oct examination in the BBPJN North Sumatra road-tender bribery case.
events.key_numbers: Re-summons Mon 26 Oct 2026 · 8 new suspects named 22 Oct, 13 suspects in total with the earlier five · tender scheme 2023-2025 · suspects identified by initials: SCH, RP, FS, HH, TRP, MM, MP, DE
events.why_it_matters: Shows whether KPK detains the one suspect who did not appear in a case tied to national road projects.

events.event: Polda Metro Jaya has rescheduled to Tuesday 27 Oct a 'clarification' summons of documentary director Dandhy Dwi Laksono over a complaint about the film 'Pesta Babi'; his legal team says he cannot attend because clarification invitations have no basis in KUHAP.
events.key_numbers: Summons Tue 27 Oct 2026 (first set 19 Oct, invitation letter 9 Oct) · report LP/B/3843/V/2026/SPKT dated 29 May 2026 by Yasinta Moiwend ('Mama Sinta') · case at inquiry (penyelidikan) stage · LBH Merauke head JTW also to be summoned, reported under the personal data protection law (Pasal 65 and 67)
events.why_it_matters: A test case on where the line between press/film freedom and criminal complaints sits, with Polri and Dandhy's lawyers (TAUD) citing different legal bases.
events.spreading_evidence: Covered by CNN Indonesia, Kompas, Kumparan, Suara, IDN Times, Pikiran Rakyat 23-24 Oct

events.event: East Jakarta District Court hears witness testimony in Roy Suryo's slander/ITE trial over former President Jokowi's diploma; the prosecution plans to call three witnesses and the defendant must attend.
events.key_numbers: Hearing Wed 28 Oct 2026, 09:00 WIB, PN Jakarta Timur (Cakung) · 3 prosecution witnesses · 19 Oct: judges rejected the defence objection and moved to evidence stage · defence asked prosecutors to bring the diploma to court
events.why_it_matters: The trial enters the stage where testimony and evidence on the diploma claim are heard in open court.
events.spreading_evidence: Antara Foto, Suara, Kompas coverage of the 19 Oct session

events.event: Indonesia marks the 98th Hari Sumpah Pemuda (Youth Pledge Day) on 28 Oct with ceremonies under the Kemenpora theme 'Patriotik, Gigih, Berempati: Pemuda untuk Indonesia'; it is not a national holiday.
events.key_numbers: Wed 28 Oct 2026, ceremony from 08:00 · 98th anniversary (Youth Pledge 1928) · theme: Patriotik, Gigih, Berempati: Pemuda untuk Indonesia
events.why_it_matters: Falls a week after student protests on the government's second anniversary, so youth-and-politics angles are likely to be in the news.

events.event: KSPI and Partai Buruh say the government is due to announce 2027 provincial minimum wages (UMP/UMSP) on 1 Nov while their wave of rallies in 38 provinces runs to 30 Oct demanding a 7.5-9.5% increase.
events.key_numbers: Rallies 15-30 Oct 2026 in 38 provinces · demand: UMP/UMSP 2027 +7.5% to +9.5% · announcement date 1 Nov 2026 (per KSPI; CNN Indonesia describes it only as the unions' request) · Manpower Minister Yassierli: formula follows the new labour rules (E0225)
events.why_it_matters: The UMP sets the pay floor for millions of workers in 2027, and employers (Kadin) say increases must track productivity.

events.event: DPR is in recess (reses) from 9 Oct to 9 Nov 2026 after closing Masa Persidangan I of the 2026-2027 session on 8 Oct, so no DPR plenary sessions are expected in the 26 Oct-1 Nov week.
events.key_numbers: Masa Persidangan I closed 8 Oct 2026 · recess 9 Oct-9 Nov 2026 · Puan listed 13 issues incl. karhutla response and KUHP/KUHAP enforcement · Forestry Bill (RUU Kehutanan) awaits a presidential letter (Surpres)
events.why_it_matters: Explains why bills such as the Forestry Bill and Election Bill will not be passed this week; commission work and hearings can still occur.
